reason: B proposes a simpler, testable intervention with direct prior support in a refractory CrNbTiZr alloy: thermal management near 500 °C reduced gradients and suppressed macrocracking, with clear residual-stress, defect, dimensional, and mechanical measurements. Its main weakness is overgeneralizing that temperature and predicting reduced porosity and higher strength across HEAs, but it is better grounded and more physically specified than A’s unsupported, underspecified feedback-control proposal.
